summary: Practise recovery messages, channel planning and feedback workflows for affected communities. Explore the five-day intermediate course.
lede: Recovery-plan communication turns changing milestones, eligibility decisions and service updates into clear information people can use. For recovery communication officers, community engagement leads and programme managers, the work includes explaining what is known or uncertain, choosing accessible channels, and setting up feedback and correction workflows so questions can be followed through.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who explain recovery decisions and service changes directly to affected communities, or who oversee the teams and information flows behind that work. It suits professionals with experience in recovery, humanitarian response, community engagement or public information.
prerequisites: Working experience in recovery, humanitarian response, community engagement, public information or a related programme role is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
